verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents public REST APIs. The Admin SDK Directory API lists and manages users, groups and devices, and the Reports API covers audit and usage data. Both have method references, machine-readable Discovery Documents, an embedded APIs Explorer, and versioned endpoints with dated deprecations. The Cloud Identity API and Apps Script add further programmatic routes. The missing llms.txt and OpenAPI files (404 probes) are offset by Google's Discovery format. Missing for 10: evidence covering the end-user app APIs (Gmail, Drive, Docs) beyond a Sheets v4 versioning mention, a committed deprecation window, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven use.
